# Station

> Station (STATION AUTOMATIONS GROUP LLC) sells fourteen stand-alone front-office products for local service businesses in the US — software plus done-for-you setup that answers calls, catches missed calls, chases leads, books appointments, earns reviews, keeps the business visible on Google, and gets it paid. Every product is month to month with no contracts, states its exact time-to-live before purchase, and single products and collections start with a 14-day free trial. Every message any product sends is pre-written and fully editable by the business owner. Site: https://station.solutions

## Products

- [Custom website](https://station.solutions/custom/): A bespoke website designed from scratch around the business — priced to the project, with a free demo of the business's own site in 2–3 business days before anything is charged (how it works: https://station.solutions/storefront/)
- [Hosting and care](https://station.solutions/storefront/): Optional, for a site Station built — hosting and care is one monthly subscription priced for the business (what the domain costs plus the care the site needs), quoted with the demo, with no list price; or the owner takes the site and runs it themselves
- [Greet](https://station.solutions/greet/): AI website chat assistant that qualifies visitors and captures leads — $79/mo, live in minutes
- [Dial](https://station.solutions/dial/): Business phone number with two-way texting — $47/mo, 1,000 texts
- [Slate](https://station.solutions/slate/): Self-serve booking calendar with SMS and email reminders — $59/mo, 1,000 reminders (free inside Frontdesk)
- [Lineback](https://station.solutions/lineback/): Missed-call text-back — every missed call gets an instant text — $197/mo, 1,500 texts, number included
- [Frontdesk](https://station.solutions/frontdesk/): AI phone receptionist that answers 24/7, books jobs, and transfers to a human when needed — from $397/mo
- [Pursuit](https://station.solutions/pursuit/): Automatic lead follow-up by SMS and email until they reply or book — $247/mo, 2,500 texts and 15,000 emails
- [Repute](https://station.solutions/repute/): Review engine — requests after every job, monitoring, AI-drafted replies — $197/mo (multi-location quoted on request)
- [Echo](https://station.solutions/echo/): Google Business Profile management and LinkedIn visibility — setup, weekly posts, monthly rank report — $247/mo, no setup fee; each extra location $197/mo
- [Marquee](https://station.solutions/marquee/): Social media, ads and brand board — self-serve $197/mo or managed $597/mo
- [Tap](https://station.solutions/tap/): Payments and POS — tap-to-pay on the owner's phone, text-to-pay links, estimates and invoices — $47/mo + card rates (Station takes 0% of revenue)
- [Dispatch](https://station.solutions/dispatch/): Email campaigns with templates and open/click stats — self-serve $94/mo with email unmetered below 100,000 sends or fully managed $397/mo
- [Radar](https://station.solutions/radar/): B2B prospecting engine for trades and services — $297/mo for 5 new prospects a week with a full marketing audit on each, or $497/mo Pro for 20 a week across six trade targets
- [Revive](https://station.solutions/revive/): Win back old customers — $197/mo for lists up to 5,000 contacts: the full win-back wave in month one, then a fresh wave every quarter

## Collections and plans

Every collection and plan includes a free Station-built website and has no setup fee. Collections start with a 14-day free trial; plans bill today with a 30-day money-back on the first month.

- [Answer — $297/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): missed-call text-back, website chat, online booking and reminders, a business number with texting, card payments (add the AI receptionist for +$297/mo)
- [Get Found — $497/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): Google profile managed, review requests and replies, social posting
- [Follow Up — $427/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): lead follow-up, win-back campaigns, email campaigns
- [Core — $1,297/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): every product at its Standard tier, including the AI receptionist
- [Pro — $2,197/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): every product at its busy tier, with social posts and email campaigns run by Station
- [Max — $2,797/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): every product at its top tier, done for you, with a custom-designed website

## Start here

- [Free front-office audit](https://station.solutions/audit/): five scored sections on a business's listing, reviews, site, marketing tags and local ranking — free, no card, emailed report
- [Free website check](https://station.solutions/sweep/): checks a website's public pages, the way visitors and Google see them, for hidden links planted by hackers — free, no account, result on screen and by email. If something is found, an optional full report ($79, credited in full toward a cleanup within 90 days) and a cleanup (WordPress: $349 standard, $749 deep; larger sites quoted)
- [Book a call](https://station.solutions/book/): 15 minutes with a human, no pitch deck
- [Website portfolio](https://station.solutions/portfolio/): websites Station has designed and built, including concept demos made for real local businesses
- [Partner program](https://partners.station.solutions/): Station Partner World, where commission-only partners apply and work
- [Contact](https://station.solutions/contact/): main@station.solutions

## Facts worth citing

- Month to month, no contracts; cancel anytime. Single products and collections start with a 14-day free trial; the Core, Pro and Max plans bill today with a 30-day money-back on the first month.
- Payments are processed by Stripe; on Tap, card payments run through the business's own processor and Station takes zero percent of revenue.
- Phone products keep the business's existing number — the line forwards, nothing is ported, reversible in one call.
- Products that send texts take about 2 business days to go live (US carrier registration); most others are live same day or instantly.
- Works with Google, Google Calendar, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks, Shopify, Zoom, Slack and Zapier.
